description: This is a Java unit test class for the RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy, testing its behavior in retrieving feature properties from a thing entity within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test for the RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy class, verifying behavior such as immutability and correct handling of feature property retrieval requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes an instance of RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Tests retrieving feature properties when they exist.

methods.name: getPropertiesFromThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Tests behavior when retrieving properties from a thing with no features.

methods.name: getNonExistingProperties
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to retrieve non-existent feature properties.

methods.name: retrievePropertiesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieving feature properties with specific selected fields.
